content.name: DiffusionDrive
content.description: [CVPR 2025 Highlight] Truncated Diffusion Model for Real-Time End-to-End Autonomous Driving
content.company: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (hustvl)
key_features: Truncated diffusion model for real-time end-to-end driving
Efficient action generation with reduced denoising steps
innovation_points: Truncated diffusion strategy that reduces denoising steps for real-time performance
First diffusion-based end-to-end driving model achieving CVPR Highlight
Balances generation quality with inference speed
content.application_value: 为端到端自动驾驶提供实时扩散规划方案，可直接应用于实车部署的规划模块

content.name: SparseDrive
content.description: SparseDrive: End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Sparse Scene Representation
key_features: End-to-end autonomous driving with sparse scene representation
innovation_points: Fully sparse representation from perception to planning
Removes dense BEV features, reducing computational overhead
content.application_value: 提供高效的稀疏化端到端自动驾驶方案，适合计算资源受限的部署场景

content.name: waymax
content.description: A JAX-based simulator for autonomous driving research.
key_features: Built on Waymo Open Motion Dataset
Designed for reinforcement learning and imitation learning
innovation_points: Fully differentiable simulator enables gradient-based optimization
JAX backend allows massive parallelization on TPU/GPU
content.application_value: 为自动驾驶决策规划算法提供高效的仿真训练环境，特别适合强化学习和端到端方法的训练与评估

content.name: FSDrive
content.description: [NeurIPS 2025 spotlight] FutureSightDrive: Thinking Visually with Spatio-Temporal CoT for Autonomous Driving
key_features: Spatio-temporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning for autonomous driving
Integrates VLA and world model concepts
innovation_points: Novel spatio-temporal CoT reasoning framework for driving
Bridges visual perception and action planning through explicit reasoning
content.application_value: 将CoT推理引入自动驾驶决策过程，提升模型的可解释性和复杂场景处理能力

content.name: AutoVLA
content.description: [NeurIPS 2025] AutoVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Adaptive Reasoning and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
innovation_points: Adaptive reasoning that adjusts computation based on scene complexity
End-to-end trainable with both imitation and reinforcement learning
content.application_value: 展示了VLA模型结合强化学习微调在端到端驾驶中的潜力，为L3+自动驾驶提供新思路
